title: Same-Visit Courtesy Share: Workmanship Warranties Truth Table
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, the same-visit courtesy share on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty, being the share of the parts diagnostic charges booked on the coverage less than one whole calendar month before that the same-visit courtesy takes, follows the covered findings recorded on the inspection date of the coverage's most recent not-covered finding, together with the courtesy rental days authorized for the rework of the concern of the coverage's most recent covered finding: two or more covered findings that day and courtesy rental days above zero on that rework, the multi-finding courtesy share of 0.12 (12 per cent); exactly one covered finding that day and courtesy rental days above zero on that rework, the single-finding courtesy share of 0.08 (8 per cent); any other case, the standard courtesy share, no different share applying.

## Truth table

| Covered findings on the date of the most recent not-covered finding | Courtesy rental days authorized on the rework of the most recent covered finding's concern | Same-visit courtesy share |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | above zero | 12 per cent |
| exactly one | above zero | 8 per cent |
| two or more | zero, or no network rework authorization | the standard courtesy share |
| exactly one | zero, or no network rework authorization | the standard courtesy share |
| none | any | the standard courtesy share |

## Inputs

- **The visit date:** the inspection date of the coverage's most recent inspection that found a concern not covered.
- **Covered findings that day:** inspections on the coverage dated that day that found a concern covered.
- **Courtesy rental days on that rework:** the courtesy rental days recorded on the network rework authorizations of the concern of the coverage's most recent covered finding, taken together.

## Hypothetical illustration

On one inspection date an electrical part was found not covered and two concerns were found covered; the later covered concern's network rework authorization carries 4 courtesy rental days. The share is 12 per cent. With 0 courtesy rental days on that authorization, the share would be the standard courtesy share.
